items.html: And we shall return to explain this matter of the loan and borrowing, what its meaning is. Behold, it was explained by us in many places that at the beginning of the Atzilut of Rachel, the Nukva of ZA, who is the Sefira of Malchut among the ten Sefirot of Atzilut, she was not emanated except in the aspect of a single point alone, and that point is her root and her existence.
